title: Proximus mobile network disrupted on 20 November; company says software bug, rules out cyberattack
geo_basis: operator headquarters in Brussels; the pages name no affected regions
summary: Belgian outlets citing Belga report that calls and SMS on Proximus's mobile network were disrupted on 20 November 2026, between 09:45 and 10:10. La Libre adds that problems returned from 12:50. Spokesperson Fabrice Gansbeke attributes it to a software bug linked to an update carried out the night before, according to the reports. Both pages say Proximus ruled out a cyberattack and that its teams are working on a solution.
plain: Proximus customers in Belgium had trouble with calls and texts on 20 November. The company says it was a software bug, not a cyberattack.
exec: A national mobile network had call and SMS problems; the operator attributes them to a software bug after an update.
impact: Calls and SMS disrupted; the pages give no figures and no restoration time for the later problems reported by La Libre.

validation.note: La Libre and La DH both carry the same Belga report, so they count as one source; Proximus's own statement not read. Only La Libre reports the return of problems from 12:50. The 7sur7 page in the original lead answered 403.

review.note: Both pages are Belga copy; 12:50 return of problems only in La Libre, so removed twice from title and attributed it to La Libre in summary, exec, impact; times, spokesperson, bug and no-cyberattack match
